procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: In the middle of the first beat, BEL 221112 on starboard on a converging course with TUR 191912 on port.
1 boat length from BEL 221112, TUR 191912 bore away.
Then BEL 221112 bore away as well.
Contact occurred between the bow of TUR 191912 and port aft transom of the hull of BEL 221112.
Damage occurred as a breakage of the hull of BEL 221112.
conclusions: TUR 191912 on port tack failed to keep clear of BEL 221112 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
TUR 191912 did not avoid contact with BEL 221112 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
It was not reasonably possible for BEL 221112 the right-of-way boat to avoid contact with TUR 191912 when it became clear that TUR 191912 was not keeping clear. BEL 221112 did not break RRS 14(a).
